admission.justification: An unpublished attempt treated as recoverable could lock a request that has no published bytes and block a plain retry.

applicability: A direct-landing refusal that is provably unpublished.
conditions: The attempt's generation was not published, so cancellation and preparation restore are safe.
exclusions: A publication that became visible; only recovery may proceed there.
statement: An unpublished direct-landing refusal restores preparation and cancels its generation, while an irreversible publication retains recovery.
